_doc: The English gate's lexicon (gate_language.py). Its Portuguese is the pt_BR column of project/data/i18n less the words of its en column, plus `portuguese` here: words the code, ids and documents wrote that no translation holds. `english`: words both languages write, never a finding (grade, interior, final, via; sim and num as the code's abbreviations). `names`: proper names and the titles of sources cited in their own language (a standard, a book, a place, a person), taken out of a line before its words are judged. A word comes off `english` and a name off `names` only when nothing in the tree writes it any more.
names: Manual Brasileiro de Sinalização de Trânsito
